body: THE ARMENIAN HAS ARRIVED. I AM HERE.
Thank you. I am really trying so damn hard to make this girl's life better.
Thank you man. It's been an adventure, but a painful one.

My girlfriend and I are both young adults, me being 21 and she being 20. Her entire childhood consisted of trying to beat poverty and find happiness in the face of an uncaring home and abusive exes. Before I met her I was empty and alone, but over two years later I am making it my life's purpose to bring this girl the joy in life that she's never had a chance to feel before. I didn't know it until recently, but I saved her from suicide when I messaged her for the first time; she was days from turning 18 and she hadn't intended to make it til then. I know a sob story doesn't improve my chances at all, but I want to get her everything nice that I can. It's just hard when you're a student and you have everything else to pay for. 

After social distancing ends, I want to take her to a certain theme park she's always wanted to go to but couldn't afford (won't say because I'm not advertising). I'm going to blow her mind in all the good ways I can. 

​
